text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “HPNS”……。

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... good morning.
I'm sorry, did I wake you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"All green."
—『Everything's fine』.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (Neo Universe-san. From my generation, though she debuted a bit before me... A person of extraordinary brilliance.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Even knowing the real me, she doesn't find me creepy...
A slightly mysterious――roommate of mine.)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Is Still in Love feeling... "restless" right now?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps you are right.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to debut soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I was simply enraptured...
By the beauty of their running, by the dazzling brilliance of the races.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(I only wished to dive into that world.
That was all I wanted, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ("That girl"... has awakened.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Scary—terrifying—not normal—
That girl is... a monster.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(With every run, everyone around me disappeared.
Even so... I couldn't bring myself to choose giving up.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(That was when...
she reached out her hand to me—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Does Still in Love have... an "intimate partner"?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know if it's to that extent, but...
If it's just someone I personally... want to make happy, then yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If I win,
I'm sure... I can return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please, don't come out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is finally making her Debut.
Most Umamusume would be nervous
right about now, but... she was a little different.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please... please,
don't let me make a fool of myself...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
Just thinking about what would happen if she went out of control...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: On this important day, to show everyone such an unsightly, disgraceful display...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It would expose them to the public.
It would even taint the memories of others...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before our contract, Still in Love was able to magnificently suppress her surging instincts.
I saw it myself, so there's no doubt about it."
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll go well this time, too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
......However,
this will be my first serious race.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If provoked, there is a chance she might become uncontrollable...
choice_data_list: ...Then let's try looking at it the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The opposite, is it?
choice_data_list: Why am I feeling this anxious...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because...
it's my precious Make Debut, after all...
choice_data_list: Right. It's your precious first step.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: It might be tough, but I want you to have fun.
It might be tough, but I want you to have fun.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Have fun...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I want to... have fun too—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look at that girl over there...
She's super pumped up!
Hey! Keep it up~~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Make Debut races really are wonderful.
You can feel the nervous excitement and
the sparkling thrill of the Umamusume better than anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Look, she's my childhood friend!
Isn't she amazing~? Let's cheer for her!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...None of their gazes are directed at me.
Even so... that is quite all right.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Stay reserved... don't stand out...—
So this instinct isn't noticed...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please... I hope you enjoy it.
